info.name: Motorcycle Management API v3.0 - Persistent Login
info.description: Complete API collection with 90-day Persistent Login & Primary Vehicle System. All data endpoints require authentication. Guest mode has been completely removed.

item.name: Authentication

request.description: Register user baru. OTP akan dikirim ke email dan disimpan otomatis ke environment variable.
Verifikasi email dengan OTP. Akan mendapat access_token & refresh_token.
Login dan mendapat access_token (30 menit) + refresh_token (90 hari).
Refresh access token menggunakan refresh token. Dapat access_token & refresh_token baru.
Get data user yang sedang login.
Kirim ulang OTP ke email.
Request reset password. OTP akan dikirim ke email.
Reset password dengan OTP.
Change password untuk user yang sudah login.
Logout dan revoke semua token (access + refresh).

item.description: Endpoint untuk autentikasi dengan sistem refresh token

item.name: User Profile

request.description: Get current user profile with stats (total_vehicles, total_trips, total_km)
Update user profile. All fields are optional. If changing password, current_password is required along with new_password (min 8 chars) and new_password_confirmation.
Delete user profile avatar

item.description: Endpoints for managing user profile and settings

item.name: Vehicles - Primary System

request.description: Tambah motor baru. Motor pertama otomatis jadi primary.
Get motor utama user. Endpoint ini yang akan digunakan dashboard & fitur lainnya.
List semua motor milik user.
Get detail motor by ID.

exec: console.log(' Second vehicle created, ID:', response.data.id);

request.description: Tambah motor kedua. Tidak otomatis jadi primary karena sudah ada primary.
Set motor sebagai primary. Motor lain otomatis jadi non-primary.
Update data motor.
Hapus motor (soft delete).

item.description: Endpoint untuk manajemen kendaraan dengan sistem primary vehicle

item.name: Service Schedules

exec: console.log(' Service schedule created, ID:', response.data.id);

request.description: Create a KM-based service schedule. reminder_option_id is optional - you can create schedules without setting a reminder.
Create a time-based service schedule. reminder_option_id is optional - this example shows creating without a reminder.
List schedules, filter by vehicle_id, is_active, schedule_type
Get schedule detail by id
Update schedule (partial/sometimes fields accepted)
Delete schedule by id

Get all service schedules for primary vehicle with live status evaluation based on current odometer. Status dinamis: Darurat (critical), Segera (warning), Aman (normal). Otomatis switch ketika ganti primary vehicle.
Evaluate all active schedules for a specific vehicle and return status (critical/warning/normal)

item.description: Service Schedule master data & evaluation endpoints

item.name: Trips

request.description: Simpan trip dari GPS tracking. Odometer kendaraan akan otomatis ter-update saat status=completed. Notifikasi akan dikirim dengan odometer terbaru.

exec: console.log(' Manual distance added, Trip ID:', response.data.id);

request.description: Tambah jarak manual tanpa GPS tracking. Odometer akan otomatis ter-update dan notifikasi dikirim dengan odometer terbaru. Cocok untuk kasus lupa nyalakan tracking atau input jarak dari luar app.
Dapatkan daftar semua trip dengan pagination. Bisa difilter berdasarkan vehicle_id.
Dapatkan detail trip termasuk semua GPS points.
Hapus trip (soft delete).

item.description: Trip tracking endpoints - supports GPS tracking and manual distance entry with auto odometer update

item.name: Device Tokens (FCM Push)

exec: console.log(' FCM Token registered, ID:', response.data.id);

request.description: Register FCM token untuk push notification. Panggil saat app pertama dibuka, token di-refresh, atau user login. Requires authentication with Bearer token.
Hapus FCM token. Panggil saat user logout atau app di-uninstall.
Cek status device token yang terdaftar. Useful untuk debugging push notification.

item.description: FCM Device Token management for push notifications - supports both authenticated & guest mode

request.description: Get all active notification categories for tab navigation

query.description: Filter by category (service, trip, alert, insight)

query.description: Filter: service, trip, alert, insight, system

request.description: Get notifications filtered by category key (service, trip, alert, insight, system)
Notifikasi kategori Servis: pengingat servis, servis jatuh tempo, servis terlambat
Notifikasi kategori Perjalanan: perjalanan selesai, jarak ditambahkan, odometer ter-update
Notifikasi kategori Peringatan: servis darurat, servis terlambat, peringatan penting lainnya
Notifikasi kategori Insight: rekomendasi servis, tips perawatan, insight pola penggunaan
Notifikasi kategori Sistem: update aplikasi, maintenance, pengumuman sistem
Get only unread notifications
Kombinasi filter: Hanya notifikasi servis yang belum dibaca
Kombinasi filter: Hanya notifikasi perjalanan yang belum dibaca
Kombinasi filter: Hanya notifikasi peringatan yang belum dibaca (PRIORITAS TINGGI)
Get single notification detail
Mark a specific notification as read
Mark all user notifications as read
Delete a notification
Get all notification templates grouped by category with user's preference status (enabled/disabled). Returns both category-level and template-specific preferences.
Toggle notification preference for a specific template. Set is_enabled to true to enable, false to disable. Provide either template_id or category_key, not both.
Toggle notification preference for an entire category. This will affect all templates in the category unless they have specific template-level preferences.
Reset notification preference to default (enabled). Provide either template_id or category_key to reset. Alternative body example: {"category_key": "service"}
